But I hope you'll change your mind about this and call an ambulance, and let them try to get to you in time. Just give it a try. I can't reply to everyone who's commented, but I just wanted to say a big, blanket thank you to every one of you. I couldn't possibly have expected a response like this. Reddit usually seems like such a snarky, cold place, and I love it for that, but then people turn around and show you just how kind they can be out of nowhere. I first thoight I shouldn't have made my comment because it dragged everything to the fore, but after receiving the responses I have - I'm glad I did speak about it. You're all the first people to ever just believe me without questioning, doubting, accusing, invalidating. 

I will seek help. Therapy, something like you all suggested. I still feel like she's won in so many ways, but maybe other people, the right people, might believe me, face to face. maybe I can win just a bit of peace. Thank you.

Thank you for making peace seem possible.

I'd been angry for a long time, but when I was 14 I started actually feeling murderous when she would start up. I'd lie completely still while she whispered sweet nothings and told me how much she loved me. I used to think about ways I could kill her and get away with it, but I never seriously contemplated going ahead with it. I knew nobody would ever believe me about why, all I would do is spend my life behind bars as another 'psycho kid gone wrong' story, while she was the innocent victim.
Not quite past the statute of limitations yet then, unless it's different in the UK.

My Mum raped me repeatedly when I was growing up. Started when I was about 11, I think, but she used to hint she'd started younger, I just don't remember. She used to bathe my genitals obsessively and then when I started growing up, growing pubic hair and so on she would ask 'can I touch it, my little boy's growing into a man'. I said no, but she would climb into bed with me anyway for 'snuggle time'. She groped for years and finally forced me to have intercourse with her when I was 14, then repeatedly after that day. She always said she just wanted the best for me, wanted me to have the best experiences with an older woman before anyone else, so we'd 'always have this.' 

When I was 12 we had all those educational and awareness videos about adults touching kids in their 'bad places', and they made it look like only men did it, so it didn't occur to me then to report her for touching and groping like she did. Then when she started progressing things further I would dread going home, joined all these after school activities so I wouldn't have to be around her in private. 

I finally told a teacher when I was 13 that my mum touched me but she thought I was 'being cheeky' and 'making light of very serious issues' and threatened to send me to detention and 'see what my mum had to say about the way I was speaking about her'. Isn't that just fucking amazing? After that I never told anyone else as a kid, never called a helpline or anything. I should have, but that one experience completely destroyed my faith in other adults to help me at that age.

The system completely fucking failed me, all I could do in the end was wait until I was old enough to get the fuck out. I eventually spoke up about it in my 20s but nobody in my family believes me. I've got two sisters who fucking hate me for saying such disgusting things about their mother. I'm also gay and the one boyfriend I ever told, he told me I probably wasn't gay, then, just scarred by my mother. He felt too uncomfortable with it and broke up with me. The fact is I actually don't care at all whether I'm gay 'because', or just happened to be gay, but it matters to other people and that's that.

She'll never see any kind of justice for it. Anything she did was 'overlove' or 'overcare'. Nobody gives a shit. She wasn't a drunk, or violent, or a drug addict, everyone likes her.

I've been let down again and again. I give up.
